scripts.build:app: pnpm build:views && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target cargo build --manifest-path app/Cargo.toml --bin app
scripts.test: node --test tests/http.test.mjs tests/features.test.mjs && pnpm test:dev && pnpm test:codegen
scripts.test:codegen: node scripts/views.mjs --check && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target cargo run --manifest-path app/Cargo.toml --bin typegen -- --root app --check
